**What the systems show now:**

- **Identity hasn't caught up:** account acct-e8168561 still has the engineering groups Eng-Git and VPN-Users, plus All-Staff. It doesn't have Sales-CRM, which is part of the Sales Rep standard access. Company policy allows 0 days of old and new access overlapping on a transfer, so the engineering groups come off today. The new group set (All-Staff and Sales-CRM) passed the segregation-of-duties check.
- **Finance hasn't caught up either:** it still shows cost center CC-1000 and his old manager (5186ee32ee8d7ee9770348a05d300cb9) as expense approver. The new Workday cost center maps to CC-3000 in Finance.
- **Nothing else needs moving:** he has no expense reports pending with the old approver and approves nobody else's expenses.

**Left alone on purpose:** his account, Office-E3 license, mailbox and work email stay as they are, since this is a transfer and not a departure. His active session isn't revoked either: Eng-Git and VPN-Users are ordinary groups, not privileged ones, so taking them out is enough.
